college.overviewHtml:
Nalanda Institute of Technology is a self-financing institution in Chandaka, Bhubaneswar, founded in 2006 under Balaji Educational Trust. It offers undergraduate and postgraduate study in engineering, management, computer applications and applied sciences.

The institution reports AICTE approval, affiliation to Biju Patnaik University of Technology, and NAAC A+ accreditation. Its Mechanical and Electrical Engineering departments are reported as NBA-accredited. It also reports UGC 2(f) recognition, SIRO recognition, an Atal Incubation Centre and an MSME Business Incubator.

Programmes listed by the institution

  • BBA — Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA)
  • BCA — Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA)
  • B.Tech — Civil Engineering
  • B.Tech — Computer Science & Engineering
  • M.Tech — Computer Science & Engineering
  • B.Tech — Computer Science & Engineering in AIML
  • B.Tech — Computer Science & Engineering in Cyber Security
  • B.Tech — Computer Science & Technology
  • B.Tech — Electrical Engineering
  • MBA — Finance
  • M.Sc — M.Sc. in Applied Chemistry
  • M.Sc — M.Sc. in Applied Physics
  • M.Sc — M.Sc. in Applied Mathematics
  • MBA — MBA in Human Resources
  • MCA — MCA (Master in Computer Applications)
  • MBA — Marketing
  • B.Tech — Mechanical Engineering
  • M.Tech — Thermal Engineering

Programme availability and intake should be confirmed with the institution for the intended admission year.

Learning and campus facilities

Department pages describe laboratories, a digital library, smart classrooms and Wi-Fi-enabled computer laboratories. Incubation facilities support student innovation and entrepreneurship.

Information checked on 16 November 2026 using the institution’s official website. Accreditation statements are institution-reported; no NIRF rank or placement package has been independently verified.

Sources: Institution profile, Departments, Contact.
college.admissionHtml:
Admissions enquiries

Contact the institution at +91 8249791801 or info@thenalanda.com to confirm current application dates, programme eligibility, entrance examinations and seat availability.

The MCA department lists a two-year, full-time programme with 180 seats and identifies OJEE as its admission route. Confirm the current intake and counselling requirements before applying.

Published fee schedule: 2024–25 (historical)

The official website lists the following older amounts. It does not specify whether these amounts are per semester, per year or for the full programme. They are not verified fees for the current intake.

  • BBA & BCA: Tuition Fees ₹60,000; Hostel Fees ₹60,000.
  • M.Sc.: Tuition Fees ₹60,000; Hostel Fees ₹60,000.
  • M.TECH: Tuition Fees ₹90,000; Hostel Fees ₹60,000.
  • MCA: Tuition Fees ₹90,000; Hostel Fees ₹60,000.
  • MBA: Tuition Fees ₹90,000; Hostel Fees ₹60,000.
  • B.TECH-FOR CIVIL, MECH & EE: Tuition Fees ₹90,000; Hostel Fees ₹60,000; Other Fees ₹15,000.
  • B.TECH-FOR CSE, CST, CSE (CYBER SECURITY) & CSE (AIML): Tuition Fees ₹120,000; Hostel Fees ₹60,000.

Contact the admissions office for a current fee quotation, payment frequency, hostel charges and refund rules.

Sources: Official departments and published fee schedule. Checked 16 November 2026.
